title: Rioux Test for Catecholates
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.icrcav6

steps.title: Prepare Acidic Base
steps.instruction: Mix 0.2 mL of 20% sulfuric acid with 2.3 mL of H2O.

steps.title: Add Sample or Standard
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the sample, H2O (for blank), or DHBA (for standard curve).

steps.title: Add Ferric Ammonium Citrate
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 mL of 1% ferric ammonium citrate (prepared in 0.09 N H2SO4) and mix.

steps.title: Add Ammonium Fluoride
steps.instruction: Add 0.4 mL of 2 M ammonium fluoride and mix.

steps.title: Add Penanthroline or Water
steps.instruction: Add 0.4 mL of 1% 1,10-penanthroline and mix, or add 0.4 mL water for a turbidity blank.

steps.title: Add Hexamethyl Tetramine
steps.instruction: Add 0.6 mL of 3 M hexamethyl tetramine.

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Heat the mixture to 60ºC for 1 hour.

steps.title: Cool and Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Cool the sample to room temperature and read the absorbance in a spectrophotometer at 510 nm.
